title: Podcast Queue Overflow Hours
dataSources: AntennaPod episodes (`antennapod:episode`), Audible listening sessions (`audible:listen`), Goodreads audiobooks (`goodreads:audiobook`), podcast queues (`podcast:queue`), and listening streaks (`listen:streak`).
app: AntennaPod listening exports, Audible progress logs, Goodreads audiobook shelves, podcast queue snapshots, and listening streak counters ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=podcast:queue queue_hours=* episodes_queued=*
| where queue_hours>20
| sort - queue_hours
| table queue_name episodes_queued queue_hours
description: Lists podcast queues whose total queued hours exceed twenty hours of listening backlog.
value: Queue overflow means discovery outran listening; pruning prevents guilt-driven unsubscribes.
implementation: Snapshot AntennaPod or app queues nightly with `queue_hours` and review overflow queues weekly.
visualization: Table of queues sorted by backlog hours.
grandmaExplanation: It counts podcast queues so long you would need a whole day just to catch up.
